fields.label: Route
fields.description: The pool this row sanctions. Every seat belongs to a route - that is what a seat matrix is

fields.label: Category
fields.description: Blank means the whole route, whatever the applicant's category. A row naming a category is the more specific claim and wins over a blank one - so a matrix can state 60 seats on Government Quota and 15 of them for one category without arithmetic in a second place

fields.label: Sanctioned Seats
fields.description: How many seats this pool is sanctioned for. Zero is meaningful - a route the institution runs but has no seats on this year

fields.label: Remarks
fields.description: The notification or sanction letter this row comes from
